spans.s: मग् vt. 1P (pres. मंगति) To go, to move.
मगध (I) m. 1. Name of a country, the southern part of the modern Behar, अगाधसत्वो मगधप्रतिष्ठः R.ii.21, i.31; 2. a bard, a minstrel.
मगध (II) m. pl. The people of Magadha.
मगधा f. 1. Long pepper; 2. the town of the Magadhas.
मागध (I) a. (f. धी) Relating to the Magadhas or to the country of Magadha.
मागध (II) m. pl. Name of a people.

मागध (III) m. 1. A king of the Magadhas; 2. a mixed caste said to have sprung from a Kṣatriya mother and Vaiśya father; (the members of this caste are professional panegyrists), Yaj.i.94; 3. a bard in general.
मगध-पुरी f. the city of Magadha.
मग्न a. (f. ग्ना) 1. Plunged; 2. immersed; 3. absorbed, (pp. of मस्ज् q.v.).
मग्न a. (f. ग्ना) 1. Plunged; 2. immersed; 3. absorbed, (pp. of मस्ज् q.v.).
मागध (I) a. (f. धी) Relating to the Magadhas or to the country of Magadha.
मागधी f. 1. A princess of the Magadhas, R.i.57; 2. name of a Prākṛt dialect; 3. a kind of jasmine; 4. long pepper; 5. refined sugar; 6. a kind of cardamoms.
मागधिक m. A king of the Magadhas.
